_doc: Curated OwlGate listing. One line per CPU (circuits contract). Enable = change "on":false to "on":true. chain 56=BNB (live), 196=X Layer (not wired yet, ignored). mining=false -> site shows Not mining, no BEM/payback. cert=true only for CPUs certified by the TapeOut factory. listedAt (YYYY-MM-DD) drives the 14-day Newly listed badge. Key is the address; names are display only (names on-chain are spoofed).
